routeError.title: This page could not be displayed
routeError.description: Something went wrong while opening this page. The rest of the app is still running — retry, or choose another item in the sidebar.

incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: WePrompt opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart WePrompt.

incompleteInstallation.title: WePrompt installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest WePrompt. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest WePrompt package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined WePrompt components.

genericFailure.title: Local backend could not start
genericFailure.description: WePrompt could not complete local startup. Restart WePrompt. If the issue continues, save the diagnostic package for support.
genericFailure.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: WePrompt package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This WePrompt package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. Get the {{expectedArch}} installer from your approved internal distribution channel, close WePrompt, and install that package.

databaseLineage.title: This database needs a compatible WePrompt version
databaseLineage.description: AionCore stopped before changing your database because its migration history is not compatible with this WePrompt package (reason: {{reason}}, applied: {{appliedVersion}}, supported floor: {{floorVersion}}, bundled latest: {{latestVersion}}). This compatibility check did not change the database schema or data, including its WAL and SHM journal files. Do not rebuild or replace the database. Close WePrompt and install an approved version that supports this database, or save diagnostics for support.
databaseLineage.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: WePrompt opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling WePrompt may not fix this. Save the diagnostic package locally so the database migration can be reviewed.
dataMigration.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: WePrompt opened, but AionCore stopped while repairing local agent cache data. Reinstalling WePrompt may not fix this. Save the diagnostic package locally so the local database can be reviewed.
localDataRepair.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: WePrompt opened, but AionCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart WePrompt.
startupDirectory.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: WePrompt detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, WePrompt will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Saving diagnostics does not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: WePrompt is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another WePrompt startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart WePrompt.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsReportFailed: Could not save the diagnostic package
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: Saving diagnostics does not modify the local database.
